message.content: {"question": "The Poisson law for the gravitational potential V is (where ρ is the mass density and G the gravitational constant):", "options": {"A": "∂²V/∂x² + ∂²V/∂y² + ∂²V/∂z² = ρ", "B": "∂V/∂x + ∂V/∂y + ∂V/∂z = 4πGρ", "C": "∂²V/∂x² + ∂²V/∂y² + ∂²V/∂z² = -4πGρ", "D": "∂V/∂x + ∂V/∂y + ∂V/∂z = -4πGρ"}, "correct": "C"}
